source_text: The debate highlighted nomenclature biases, with "mutilation" applied pejoratively to FGM but neutrally to male circumcision ("cutting" vs. "surgery"), reflecting institutional hesitancy to alienate religious majorities despite shared non-therapeutic roots. [40]
